additive_build_content:
load("@rules_cc//cc:defs.bzl", "cc_import", "cc_library")
cc_import(
    name = "native_library",
    shared_library = "site-packages/mujoco/libmujoco.so.3.17.0",
)
cc_library(
    name = "native",
    hdrs = glob(["site-packages/mujoco/include/**/*.h"]),
    includes = ["site-packages/mujoco/include"],
    deps = [":native_library"],
    target_compatible_with = ["@platforms//cpu:x86_64", "@platforms//os:linux"],
    visibility = ["//visibility:public"],
)
